crossRefs.note: There you shall build an altar to Yahweh your God, an altar of stones. You shall not use any iron tool on them.
You shall build Yahweh your God’s altar of uncut stones. You shall offer burnt offerings on it to Yahweh your God.
as Moses the servant of Yahweh commanded the children of Israel, as it is written in the book of the law of Moses: an…

translations.web: If you make me an altar of stone, you shall not build it of cut stones; for if you lift up your tool on it, you have polluted it.
translations.bsb: Now if you make an altar of stones for Me, you must not build it with stones shaped by tools; for if you use a chisel on it, you will defile it.
translations.kjv: And if thou wilt make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stone: for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted
translations.asv: And if thou make me an altar of stone, thou shalt not build it of hewn stones; for if thou lift up thy tool upon it, thou hast polluted it.
